name: How long do kitchen plumbing upgrades take?

mainEntity.name: How long do kitchen plumbing upgrades take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of kitchen plumbing upgrades varies significantly based on the project's complexity. Simple tasks like replacing a faucet might take a few hours. Installing a new garbage disposal or a standard sink can often be completed within a day. More extensive upgrades, such as rerouting water lines, installing a new dishwasher, or a complete overhaul of under-sink plumbing, can take several days, especially if other kitchen renovations are occurring concurrently. Your contractor can provide a more accurate timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: The time varies: a few hours for small jobs, a day for standard installations, and several days for more complex upgrades.
